domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n greater than 1
the expression x plus m is therefore a real number, so E_n is evaluated only at real inputs
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n with n greater than 1, for every real number x, and for every integer m, the function E_n satisfies E_n of (x plus m) equals E_n of x.
quantifier_order: for all integer n such that n > 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: index parameter of the function E_n; universally quantified

variables.name: m
variables.role: integer translation amount added to x; universally quantified

witness_dependencies: no existential quantifiers; no witnesses are introduced

statement_nl: For every integer n>1, every real number x, and every integer m, one has E_n(x + m) = E_n(x).
